task.title: Close out distribution/restore rehearsal and provenance inventory
task.input: All final acceptance reports, existing deploy scripts, actual main/head checks and recovery sources reused in this round
task.output: delivery-acceptance: exact-version distribution artifacts, schema/restore rehearsal and unresolved-item inventory
task.accept: 1) Only in isolation, use reviewed-SHA artifacts to execute backup, Prisma diff, plan-check, db push without accept-data-loss, zero drift, standalone startup and a home computed-style/real-request/event smoke. Restore an actual backup into disposable PostgreSQL and read it through the app. Record actual old-image compatibility/rollback and credential-revocation results; listing a backup file alone is insufficient. 2) Collect exact heads, commands, statuses, trace/GIF evidence and open items from the five acceptance themes. Live-check head/check/provenance/permissions for every recovery PR reused this round; missing bot approval is not merge-ready. Keep unfinished media/external dependencies visible and never automatically merge, deploy, delete production data or purchase a service.
